title: In memoriam: Charles de Haes

sections.heading: Body
sections.text:
Posted on April, 22 2026
WWF marks with great sadness the passing of Charles de Haes, former Director General of WWF International.
Charles served as WWF International’s second Director General from 1975 to 1993, leading the organization during a pivotal period in its history.
At a time when global awareness of environmental challenges was rapidly growing, Charles helped shape the direction WWF would take for decades to come. Under his leadership, WWF expanded its mission beyond wildlife protection to encompass biodiversity conservation, sustainability, and environmental policy, strengthening its role in driving the international conservation agenda.
During this period, WWF’s global presence grew with the expansion of the WWF Network, particularly in biodiversity‑rich countries where conservation action was most urgently needed.
Key developments during Charles’s tenure helped lay important foundations for the WWF as it exists today, including the strengthening of the WWF brand and the organization’s evolution from World Wildlife Fund to the World Wide Fund for Nature.
Charles is remembered with respect and appreciation for his leadership and for the lasting contribution he made to WWF. Our thoughts are with his family and with the many colleagues who worked with him over the years.
